title: Open a practice folder
summary: Opening a folder gives the editor a workspace for related files. Use a new folder made only for learning.
introduction: Opening a folder gives the editor a workspace for related files. Use a new folder made only for learning. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Opening a folder gives the editor a workspace for related files. Use a new folder made only for learning.
The Explorer can show the page and stylesheet together. A folder name helps you recognise the project.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Create a notes.txt file inside the practice folder.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not open a sensitive or unfamiliar project and immediately trust or run all its tasks.
